div.p: Comprehensive physical and mental health services — because thriving academically starts with feeling your best. All services are confidential and available to every enrolled student.

div.div: Your wellbeing is our priority. All health and counseling services are confidential. Students enrolled in the university health plan receive services at no additional cost. Walk-ins are welcome during regular hours.
div.p: Located in the Axion Wellness Center on North Campus, our Student Health Center provides primary and preventive care to all enrolled students. Board-certified physicians, nurse practitioners, and registered nurses staff the clinic year-round.
Diagnosis and treatment of acute illness, minor injuries, and chronic condition management. Same-day appointments available for urgent concerns.
Stay ahead of illness with routine screenings, immunizations, and annual wellness exams. Required vaccinations can be verified or administered here.
On-site lab for rapid testing and routine blood work. Results typically available within 24–48 hours, with urgent results communicated directly by your provider.
On-campus pharmacy dispenses most common prescriptions at reduced cost for students. Over-the-counter medications and wellness supplies are also available.

The Axion Counseling Center provides free, confidential mental health support to all enrolled students. Our licensed therapists, psychologists, and counselors are here to help you navigate life's challenges.

div.class: side-nav border-0 text-center p-4 h-100 reveal
div.p: One-on-one sessions with a licensed counselor. Available weekly with a limit of 12 free sessions per academic year. Extended sessions available on a sliding-scale basis.

div.class: side-nav border-0 text-center p-4 h-100 reveal reveal-delay-1
div.p: Structured group sessions on topics like anxiety, depression, relationship skills, grief, and identity. New groups form each semester — no session limit.

div.class: side-nav border-0 text-center p-4 h-100 reveal reveal-delay-2
div.p: Video and phone sessions available for students who are remote, studying abroad, or prefer virtual care. Schedule through the student portal.
If you're in immediate distress, same-day crisis appointments are available. Walk in to the Counseling Center or call our 24/7 crisis line.
Free access to our digital mental wellness platform. Mood tracking, guided meditations, CBT exercises, and 24/7 AI chat support — available on iOS and Android.
Drop-in guided meditation sessions every Tuesday and Thursday at noon. Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction (MBSR) 8-week program runs each semester.
Free yoga classes at the Recreation Center: Hatha, Vinyasa, and Restorative. Adaptive yoga available for students with mobility concerns.
Sleep hygiene workshops, individual consultations, and the SleepWell nap lounge — a quiet rest space in the library open 24/7 during finals.
Trained peer wellness educators host workshops on stress, relationships, and alcohol safety. Available for dorm floor programs and student organization events.
Confidential STI testing, contraception counseling, relationship support, and bystander intervention training through the Safe Campus Initiative.
Pop-up de-stress events during midterms and finals: therapy dogs, art therapy, aromatherapy, and free snack breaks — watch the campus event calendar.

All full-time students are automatically enrolled in the Axion Student Health Plan (ASHP), administered by BlueShield Academic. The plan provides comprehensive coverage including primary care, specialist referrals, hospitalization, mental health, and prescription benefits.

div.span: Add spouse or child to your plan

div.p: Students with comparable private insurance may waive the ASHP. Opt-out requests must be submitted by September 15 (Fall) or February 1 (Spring) through the Student Portal.
Enrollment in ASHP is mandatory for all F-1 and J-1 visa holders. The plan meets all federal visa health insurance requirements.

Free one-on-one sessions with a registered dietitian. Get personalized guidance on balanced eating, managing dietary restrictions, fueling athletic performance, or building healthy habits on a student budget.

a.class: btn btn-outline-primary rounded-pill btn-sm px-3 fw-semibold

div.p: Two free personal training sessions per semester for all students at the Recreation Center. Certified trainers will help design a program that fits your goals and schedule.

a.class: btn btn-outline-primary rounded-pill btn-sm px-3 fw-semibold

div.p: Over 40 free weekly classes: spin, HIIT, Pilates, Zumba, kickboxing, and more. Accessible to all fitness levels. Full schedule posted in the Recreation Portal.

a.class: btn btn-outline-primary rounded-pill btn-sm px-3 fw-semibold

div.p: Semester-long wellness challenges — step counts, hydration streaks, sleep goals — with prizes and community leaderboards through the WellSpace app.
